flavors.neutral: everything else: no emblem on walls, altar, statues, robes, braziers

rooms.label: Hidden entrance
rooms.reads_as: an ordinary cellar store; the way on is the bookcase door (door-secret-bookcase), straight across from the cellar door when the room stands alone

rooms.label: Processional passage
rooms.reads_as: a clear line on a runner between hooded statues and fire bowls in mirrored pairs; alcove panels in the long walls; the flavor's banners, reliefs and sculptures

rooms.label: Sanctum
rooms.reads_as: the flavor's idol on the end wall, the altar slab before it with the altar-piece, the ritual circle with the sigil on the axis, seats behind it, pillars or flavor buttresses down the long walls

rooms.label: Summoning chamber
rooms.reads_as: the plain ritual circle with the sigil dead centre, four boundary stones, tall candles, the empty arch on the far wall, the chained book on its lectern

rooms.label: Holding cells
rooms.reads_as: cages in a row facing the door, manacles, a pallet, the gaoler's table by the door, one fire

rooms.label: Robing room
rooms.reads_as: a rail of hooded robes standing in the open, peg rails of robes on the walls, a bench, chests, masks on a table

rooms.label: Forbidden library
rooms.reads_as: the chained book on its lectern in the middle, bookcases butted along the walls until half the wall is books, a reading table with bound tomes

rooms.label: Acolytes' quarters
rooms.reads_as: pallets heads to the wall, a chest at each foot, robes by the door; no arms

rooms.label: Inner sanctum
rooms.reads_as: the flavor's idol facing the one door, the offering bowl before it on the sigil, a censer each side, treasure at the walls; a secret door ajar in one vault in three
